changelog: Player settings now target the active nested player and use the owning Activity instead of the window context.
Restored native control timeout, resize and subtitle font integration with cleanup when settings change or playback closes.
Animations reconcile without repeated restarts, respect motion settings and restore owned view state.
Replaced inconsistent standard UI icon fallbacks with 253 embedded official Material vector assets.
Unsupported gesture, brightness automation and custom audio-ducking controls are clearly unavailable instead of silently doing nothing.
ATTENTION: Update through dcext or the CS3M Updater, then fully restart CloudStream.
ATTENTION: Physical-device playback and rendering verification is still pending.
